## Logistic Regression

### Single variable model

Make a logistic regression model using your best predictor variable

#### Model

```{r}
#recipe
log_rec<-
  recipe(democracy~ BESTVAR , data=FullData_2025)

#setting engine
logit_mod <-
  logistic_reg()|>
  set_engine("glm")|>
  set_mode("classification")

# workflow
glm_workflow <-
  workflow() |>
  add_recipe(log_rec)|>
  add_model(logit_mod)

# fitting model
spam_fit <-
  glm_workflow |>
  fit(data = FullData_2025)
```
